notes: Paper runs legacy Bukkit commands under /execute with the initiating sender and no as/at context; on Paper 1.20.6+ /give is therefore registered through Paper's Brigadier API with vanilla's players() argument. Spigot keeps the Bukkit command; there plugin commands are not reachable under /execute, so execute ... run give is vanilla's.

On an offline-mode server Paper's PlayerProfile#update builds an offline profile without contacting Mojang. The real lookup ran on the 26.3 lane in BungeeCord mode (proxy online mode) with forwarded logins.
